claims.climate: The rainy season in the state is between mid-May and mid-September, while the dry season constitutes a period of seven months. Kebbi state is also characterised with the tropical weather conditions of coldness, wetness and harmattan.
claims.economy: Economically, Kebbi State is largely based around fishing and agriculture, mainly of sorghum, groundnuts, millet, onions, and rice crops.
claims.people: Kebbi is mostly a Hausa and Fulani state, with Islam as the major religion.
